lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial density and smaller diameter observed toward the ventral margin and larger, more isolated centroids along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a faint grid-like structure across the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior surface to a shadowed trough on the inferior surface, extending from the posterior gill region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of small, high-intensity blobs concentrated along its leading edge and dorsal surface.
